# 1 Enoch Chapter 44 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**44:1** And-also another-phenomenon I-saw in-regard-to the-lightnings: how-some-of-the-stars-arise and-become-lightnings and-cannot-part-with their-new-form.

---

*EMET notes: Ch. 44 is the briefest chapter in the Parables — a single verse describing stars that transform into lightning and are fixed in that new form. This may describe fallen stars (fallen angels) transformed into destructive forces. The chapter closes the First Parable (chs. 38–44) before the Second Parable begins in ch. 45.*
